title: Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

vibeProfile.oneLine: Earth is demolished for a bypass, and one Englishman hitches into the absurd.

summary: Seconds before Earth is demolished to make way for a hyperspace bypass, hapless Englishman Arthur Dent is rescued by his friend Ford Prefect, who turns out to be a roving researcher for a galactic guidebook. What follows is a gloriously silly cosmic romp through depressed robots, two-headed presidents and the answer to life, the universe and everything. Adams's comic classic is one of the funniest books ever written, whip-smart beneath the daftness, and endlessly quotable.
whyReadIt: The funniest book in the galaxy, and secretly very clever. Read it with a towel and don't panic.

funFacts.text: The answer to life, the universe and everything, 42, has become one of geek culture's best-known jokes.
